status: Workshop gallery verified; same eight-image gallery included in the GitHub release source
user_direction: Replace all previous gameplay screenshots when the update is published, not append these to the old gallery.

screenshots.title: Work Area setup
screenshots.caption: Set required outfits, access permissions, a locker room and a task buffer for a Work Area. Rule colors match the painted area.

screenshots.title: Non-Work Area setup
screenshots.caption: Use a Non-Work Area to return Work outfits and prefer saved personal clothing, with optional fallback selections.

screenshots.title: Choose which Work outfits to return
screenshots.caption: All Work Outfits is selected by default. Turn it off to choose individual source rules; shared items stay on if any source is unselected.

screenshots.title: Colored selections and conflicts
screenshots.caption: Apparel selections name their source rules and use map-area colors. Muted grey entries identify outfit conflicts.

screenshots.title: Find your custom areas first
screenshots.caption: Editable custom areas appear above special game and mod areas, with colored names and map highlighting.

screenshots.title: Follow outfit preparation
screenshots.caption: See which apparel a pawn still needs, their completed buffer count, and separate hauling activity.

screenshots.title: Track work, returns and wandering
screenshots.caption: Compact hovers show the rule, completed buffer count and current outfit step. Animal and robot activity appears separately from humanlike workers.

screenshots.title: Saved personal item ownership
screenshots.caption: Inspect a saved garment to see its owner, jump to the pawn, recall them or release the saved item with confirmation.
